about.title: A local heating company Leeds families trust
about.text:
Northgate Heating started in 2009 with one van and a simple promise: turn up on time, charge a fair price and do the job right first time.

Today our team of Gas Safe registered engineers looks after thousands of homes and rental properties across Leeds, but we still run things the same way.

items.name: Sarah M.
items.text: Boiler died on a Sunday night with two little ones in the house. They had an engineer with us first thing Monday and it was fixed by 10am. Brilliant service.

items.name: James P.
items.text: Had a new Worcester combi fitted. The quote was the price we paid, the lads were tidy and explained everything. Would recommend to anyone.

items.name: Priya K.
items.text: I manage eight rental flats and Northgate handle all the gas safety certificates. Reliable, quick and they send reminders, which saves me a lot of hassle.

faqs.q: Do you offer emergency boiler repairs?
faqs.a: Yes. If you have no heating or hot water we offer same-day callouts across Leeds, seven days a week, subject to availability.

faqs.q: How much does a new boiler cost?
faqs.a: Most combi boiler replacements cost between £1,895 and £2,800 fitted, depending on the model and any pipework changes. We'll give you a fixed price before any work starts.

faqs.q: How often should my boiler be serviced?
faqs.a: Once a year. An annual service keeps your boiler safe and efficient, and most manufacturers require it to keep your warranty valid.

faqs.q: Are your engineers Gas Safe registered?
faqs.a: Every engineer who works on gas appliances is Gas Safe registered. You can check our registration number on the Gas Safe Register website.
